newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle steady/up $0.50 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle steady/up $0.50 - USDA.

text.p: USDA said slaughter steers and heifers were active at Midsession. Both classes traded steady to $0.50 higher. Demand was good by all buying interests.
Steers - part load choice predominantly 3 near 1450 lbs 65.00. High select and choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 62.50-64.50. Select and choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 61.00-62.50. Select 1-2 58.00-61.00.
Heifers - High select and choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs 62.00- 64.50. Select and choice 2-3 1000-1125 lbs 60.00-62.00. Select 1-2 58.00-60.00.
